# SwiftPython

> SwiftPython embeds Python in native Swift apps. It provides in-process calls, worker pools, process isolation, retained Python objects, streaming, Python-to-Swift callbacks and Metal data sharing.

Current commercial release: 0.7.0-preview.1. The package includes Python 3.13 and requires macOS 15 or newer and Swift 6. ExtensionFoundation worker hosting requires macOS 26. The iOS demo shows four native Python worker processes computing a Julia fractal in an iPad app. The recording uses the iPadOS simulator. The current commercial download supplies macOS binaries.

## Install

Add https://github.com/mikhutchinson/swiftpython-commercial.git through Swift Package Manager with exact version 0.7.0-preview.1. Add the SwiftPythonRuntime product to your app target. For a sidecar worker, embed SwiftPythonWorker from the matching complete distribution. Follow the getting-started and packaging guides below.

## Website

- [Home](https://swiftpython.dev/): Product overview and recorded demos.
- [Runtime](https://swiftpython.dev/runtime/): Execution models, worker ownership, shared data, callbacks and app distribution.
- [Examples](https://swiftpython.dev/examples/): Native Python on iOS, recorded in the iPadOS simulator, plus macOS Metal and callback checks.
- [Showcase](https://swiftpython.dev/showcase/): Sirius and SiriusMsg application workflows.
- [Compare](https://swiftpython.dev/compare/): SwiftPython, PythonKit, multiprocessing, Ray and Dask.
- [Documentation](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/): Installation, packaging and API chapter index.
- [Getting started](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/getting-started/): Exact package pin, first Python call and worker example.
- [Packaging](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/packaging/): Runtime embedding, Python dependencies, worker hosting and signing.
- [Licensing](https://swiftpython.dev/licensing/): Commercial SDK License 1.0 and links to the full terms.
- [Releases](https://swiftpython.dev/releases/): Current version, package products and matched downloads.

## Measurements

- [Mac and iPad duplex measurements](https://swiftpython.dev/benchmarks/duplex/): 85 trials per device on a MacBook Pro M4 Pro and a physical iPad mini A17 Pro, collected 29–30 September 2026 UTC. Receipt latency, verified transfer throughput, concurrent sessions, idle resources and measurement method.
- [Measurement report (PDF)](https://swiftpython.dev/media/duplex/swiftpython-duplex-mac-ipad.pdf): Five-page report with charts and tables.
- [Per-trial data (JSON)](https://swiftpython.dev/media/duplex/data.json): Trial parameters and statistics for both devices. Throughput counts bytes per direction and includes output verification and acknowledgement.

## API guides

- [Core runtime](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/core-runtime/): In-process Python calls, imports, objects and errors.
- [Data and shared memory](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/data-interop/): Value conversion, buffers and managed tensors.
- [Concurrency and handles](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/concurrency-handles/): Python execution, object ownership and release.
- [Worker pools](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/process-pool/): Process pools, worker affinity, lifecycle and telemetry.
- [Streaming](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/streaming/): Generators, progress events and cancellation.
- [Task graphs](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/dag/): Dependencies, worker affinity and failure policies.
- [Callbacks](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/callbacks/): Synchronous, asynchronous, reentrant and streaming Python-to-Swift calls.
- [Python packages](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/python-packages/): App-owned Swift facades and bundled Python dependencies.
- [Linux sandboxes](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/sandboxes/): Isolated tenants, shell execution and Python workloads.
- [Duplex sessions](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/duplex/): Concurrent input, output, controls and completion.
- [Audio and Metal](https://swiftpython.dev/docs/apple-interop/): Native media adapters, buffer ownership and GPU completion.

## Distribution

- [Commercial repository](https://github.com/mikhutchinson/swiftpython-commercial): Package manifest, public guides and examples.
- [Preview 1 release](https://github.com/mikhutchinson/swiftpython-commercial/releases/tag/v0.7.0-preview.1): XCFrameworks and the complete distribution.
- [Consumer kit](https://github.com/mikhutchinson/swiftpython-commercial/blob/main/Consumer/README.md): App-owned XPC services and extension worker hosts.
- [License](https://github.com/mikhutchinson/swiftpython-commercial/blob/v0.7.0-preview.1/LICENSE): Terms for Preview 1.
